errorBoundaries.globalErrorBoundary: Implemented with ChunkLoadError recovery and throttled reload loops
errorBoundaries.isolation: Granular module failures do not crash parent application shell

dynamicImportsAndChunkLoading.staleChunkReload: sessionStorage reload counter prevents infinite reload loops on new deployments
dynamicImportsAndChunkLoading.unhandledRejections: Global window handler in main.tsx captures async script failures

storageAndDataResilience.database: DocFlowStudioDB with fallback to docflow_* / opendoc_* localStorage keys
storageAndDataResilience.jsonSafeParsing: Safe try/catch recovery ignores corrupted JSON strings without throwing

memoryAndResourceCleanup.objectUrls: All URL.createObjectURL instances cleaned up via setTimeout or finally blocks
memoryAndResourceCleanup.resizeObservers: Disconnected in useEffect cleanup return handlers
memoryAndResourceCleanup.eventListeners: Window and document listeners (mouse, touch, keydown) strictly removed on unmount

defensiveFileHandling.emptyFiles: 0-byte files handled gracefully with default structural content
defensiveFileHandling.oversizedFiles: 50 MB safety threshold prevents browser tab freeze with clear warning message
defensiveFileHandling.malformedFormats: DOCX, CSV, RTF, JSON fallbacks parse without unhandled runtime exceptions

concurrencyAndDoubleActions.isMountedRef: Async file processing and state updates aborted when component unmounts
concurrencyAndDoubleActions.doubleClickGuard: PDF merge, exports, and saves guarded against rapid duplicate triggers
